We prioritize operators, founders, executives, investors, policy leaders, researchers, and infrastructure partners who are actively shaping the future of mobility. When will I hear back? + Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. If accepted, you'll receive an email with instructions to purchase your ticket. Can I get a refund on my ticket? + Tickets are non-refundable. Can I transfer my ticket? + Yes. Tickets may be transferred to another attendee if you can no longer make it. Are there group tickets? + RIDE AI is by application, so each attendee should apply individually. If you are interested in bringing a team or reserving a block of tickets, please contact us and we'll help route you to the right option. When are speakers announced? + Speakers will be announced on a rolling basis as the program is confirmed. The agenda is curated around the operators, investors, policy leaders, and technical experts who can bring the most useful perspective to the room. Where should sponsors inquire? + Sponsors can inquire through the Sponsor RIDE AI 2027 link on the event page or contact the RIDE AI team directly for sponsorship opportunities. Be there on April 7, 2027 RIDE AI 2026 sold out. Apply by October 31 : $899 early bird ticket if accepted; general admission expected to be $1,500 later.
